Triggers let you define what needs to happen for an Effect to take place. To program a Trigger, place it in a room, double click on it and set it up! You need to stack an Effect with the Trigger to make it work.

Effects are what happens after you activate a Trigger. To program an Effect, place it in your room, double click on it and set it up! You will always need to stack a Trigger with the Effect to make it work.
Conditions are specific things that need to be done before a Trigger will work. If you want to use a Condition, you will need to stack it with a Trigger and Effect.
Use Selectors to specify users and/or furni that will be used in Wired. For example, "WIRED Selector: Users in team" combined with "WIRED Effect: Teleport to furni" teleports an entire team at once!
Add-Ons are a special type of Wired that is used to add extra configurations to an existing Wired stack. Each Add-On has its own unique purpose.
Discover a new branch Wired - Wired Variables!
How do Wired Variables work?

Variables are used to store values and read them at a later point with Wired. For example, they can be used to store the amount of health points for a user. Variables can belong to users, furni, or even the entire room! You can share them across multiple rooms too. But how do you use them?

Wired Variables work different from all existing Wired boxes, because they are not stacked on top of the usual Wired boxes, like Triggers and Effect. Instead, Wired Variables form a new kind of Wired stack (lets call it a "Variable stack"), one that defines how the Variable works.

In a usual Wired stack, a Wired Effect is stacked on a Wired Trigger. In a Variable stack, there is one "WIRED Variable" and additionally you can add Variable Add-Ons on top of the stack to bring further configurations to the Wired Variable. The boxes that go on a Variable stack all share a similar design, so it's easy to know if a box belongs on a Variable!

The Wired boxes on this page is a combination of the types of Wired you all know and love, like Triggers, Effects and Conditions. The ones on this page are used specifically to work with Wired Variables

Habbo Marketplace is a convenient and safe way to buy and sell items in Habbo.
How does the Habbo Marketplace work?

Selling items:
You can sell any item which is tradable by selecting the item in your inventory and clicking on 'Sell in Marketplace'. You are able to post 5 items for sale at the cost of 1 Credit. You cannot use items current in the Shop.

Buying items:
Browse for the item you want to buy on the Marketplace Offers page and click Buy. We guarantee you'll get the item at the cheapest price available at the moment of purchase.

Requirements for use: To use the Marketplace you'll need a Trading Pass. The criteria for the pass is:  1) Your email address is verified, 2) Your account is at least 1 day old and 3) You've been online for at least 1 hour in total.

The Furni-Matic is a Furni Recycling machine! Feed your old Recyclable Furni into the machine and get a shiny new Furni in return.
Using the Furni-Matic

1. Keep the main Furni-Matic window open while clicking the 'My Stuff' button. You'll see that most of your items have recycling symbols on them, this means you can click and drag them into the Furni-Matic.. 
2. When you have enough items in there, click "Start" and look for the Furni-Matic box in your inventory. 
3. Click the box to see its tag. Open the box, or trade it unopened. The timer shows you how long you have to wait before you can feed more items to the Furni-Matic. P.S. Check out the Rewards before you recycle - don't be surprised by the surprise!

Monster Plants can sure be a handful, this page gives you some extra advice on raising and looking after your monsterous brood.
Taking Care Of Your Plant

Your plants need to be tended regularly, or else they die. To ensure a healthy plant tend it every 30 hours or so. If it dies, you can use the Revival potion to bring it back to life.
Breeding
To breed your plant you have to wait until it's fully grown. Clicking Breed on the menu will show you what other plants in the room are available to breed with.

Plant your seeds in your room and tend to keep them alive and healthy. After your plants have matured you can breed your plants to try and get leveled up offspring. Plants can only breed once without using the Rebreeding Potion.
On this page you'll find everything you need to take care of your plants: Plant Revival for when your plants die. Place potion to room, double click and select the plant you want to revive.
